description: Java entity class representing file history records within the sales manager core business logic, including properties such as store, file ID, sizes, dates, and download counts.

classes.name: FileHistory
classes.description: Entity class mapping to FILE_HISTORY table, storing historical information of files related to orders.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the file history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the file history record.

methods.name: getFilesize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: setFilesize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getDateAdded
methods.description: Returns the date when the record was added, cloned to prevent external mutation.

methods.name: setDateAdded
methods.description: Sets the date when the record was added.

methods.name: getDateDeleted
methods.description: Returns the date when the record was deleted, cloned to prevent external mutation.

methods.name: setDateDeleted
methods.description: Sets the date when the record was deleted.

methods.name: getAccountedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the record was accounted, cloned to prevent external mutation.

methods.name: setAccountedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the record was accounted.

methods.name: getDownloadCount
methods.description: Returns the download count of the file.

methods.name: setDownloadCount
methods.description: Sets the download count of the file.
